translation: A terra dará ⟨o⟩ seu ⟨que⟩ será colhido; ⟨nos⟩ abençoará Elohim, ⟨o⟩ Elohim ⟨de⟩ nós.

tokens.rationale: Hebrew definite article implied by context
Verb meaning 'to give' or 'to produce' - here 'yield' in agricultural sense
Literally 'its produce/crop' - expanded for clarity in Portuguese
Root meaning 'to kneel/bless' - here 'bless us' with implied subject
Hebrew divine name preserved as per discipline - not translated as 'Deus'
Literally 'our Elohim' - possessive suffix rendered with prepositions in Portuguese
